facts.value: The scholarship service of Goethe University supports you with personal advice regarding the various funding options.
You can find detailed information on the application and allocation procedures of the Germany Scholarship as well as the ideological support program.
The scholarship service provides an overview of scholarship opportunities, application tips, and individual counseling.
You can check if you are eligible for BAföG through personal consultation.
You can find various alternatives for financing your studies on the pages of the Student Services: https://www.studentenwerkfrankfurt.de/bafoeg-finanzierung/studienfinanzierung/
For BAföG information, contact the personal consultation of the Office for Educational Support at Campus Bockenheim: https://www.studentenwerkfrankfurt.de/bafoeg-finanzierung/bafoeg/
Detailed information about the Germany Scholarship: https://www.uni-frankfurt.de/99244696
Information about the ideological support program: https://www.uni-frankfurt.de/99248100/Ideelles_Förderprogramm
